F01.title: Seed Protection
F01.summary: Hardened check_seed_safety and validate_config_seed_integrity in pqt_qcat/core/security.py. Forbidden list [101-105] cannot be weakened by config. Core instantiation and config validator reject sealed seeds unconditionally.

F02.title: Seed Incident 100-111 Quarantine
F02.summary: Created SEED_INCIDENT.md documenting external reader seed leakage on Nov 17. Quarantined seeds 100-111 are excluded from all future confirmatory sets. M5 preregistration integrity is preserved.

F03.title: Config Plumbing
F03.summary: Plumbed wake.eta, wake.ticks_per_query, wake.coordinate_clip into wake_train_step and evaluate_query_accuracy. Resolved config is saved atomically upon execution.

F04.title: Endpoint Timing
F04.summary: generate_wake_schedule tags is_pre_new and is_post_new_pre_tail on exactly 1 event (the final event of the epoch). Tail probe occurs strictly at event 201.

F05.title: Delay Metrics Preservation
F05.summary: Preserved both immediate carry and delay1000 with complete metrics (acc, margin, nll, logits, Z_start, Z_end, Z_drift) across both old and new queries; retained in serialized JSON.

F06.title: Paired History Randomness
F06.summary: Paired histories share exact pair_run_seed = 42000 + s_idx * 1000 + m_idx * 10. Thermal noise draws and semantic grounding are identical between BLOCKED and INTERLEAVED.

F07.title: Preconditions and Gating
F07.summary: Enforced Joint >= 75%, Prefix >= 80%, Interference >= 10% gate before sleep consolidation stage. Disallowed unforced sleep_only bypassing.

F08.title: Baseline Definition
F08.summary: Interference defined strictly as I_pre_tail = Q_old(pre_new) - Q_old(post_new_pre_tail). Prefix accuracy tracked separately.

F09.title: Tick Accounting
F09.summary: Instrumented accounting of all physical steps: wake, probes, guards, sleep active, delay, rollback, and query evaluations. Idle policy explicitly marked idle_unmatched.

F10.title: Provenance and Atomic Writes
F10.summary: Atomic file writes implemented with .tmp staging and os.replace. Unique run directories, git commit SHA, diff patch, dependencies, and RNG states recorded.

F11.title: Mathematical Observability
F11.summary: Active parameter subspace aligned with E5 plastic update rows 32:35 (p=144). Directional derivative verified with fixed v across epsilons with mixed tolerance. Rank bounded by 18.

F12.title: Retractions and Reporting
F12.summary: Published ADDENDUM_RETRACTION_20261118.md formally retracting 99.2% hidden memory, physical capacity limit, vortex necessity, and correcting external reader majority baseline.
